query: Explain why some Qatar Airways Business-Class flights receive a non-recommended (Recommended = no) result.

per_column.name: aircraft_product_deprecation
per_column.rationale: Fleet age/product deprecation (newer/older/mixed fleet) is a candidate cause of a non-recommended result. It is a plausible treatment whose effect on the outcome is being attributed, and it is not named in the query.

per_column.name: catering_quality_decline
per_column.rationale: Declining catering quality is another candidate observed cause of non-recommendation. However, catering quality is also captured by the existing 'Food & Beverages' rating and may function as a mediator of overall dissatisfaction; treated here as a candidate treatment / possible mediator.

per_column.name: product_degradation_perception
per_column.rationale: Perception of product degradation (decline/cutbacks) sits on the causal path between actual product changes and the recommendation decision -- it is the passenger's evaluative judgment, which directly drives (mediates) the non-recommendation rather than being an independent common cause.

per_column.name: traveler_type_context
per_column.rationale: Traveller type (solo/couple/business/family leisure) plausibly influences both which product/fleet/service a passenger is exposed to and evaluates (treatment) and their propensity to recommend (outcome). It is a pre-treatment context variable and duplicates existing 'Type of Traveller', but here surfaced as an adjustment variable.

judge.rationale: The columns supply candidate treatments (fleet/product deprecation, catering decline) around the non-recommendation outcome, so a treatment is present. However the causal-attribution claim is only weakly satisfied: only one column (traveler_type_context) functions as a genuine common-cause confounder, and it merely restates the existing 'Type of Traveller' field rather than surfacing a novel confounder. 'product_degradation_perception' is a mediator on the treatment->outcome path (adjusting for it would be a mistake), and 'catering_quality_decline' overlaps with an existing rating and is closer to a mediator of overall dissatisfaction. No confounder that plausibly causes BOTH treatment and outcome was surfaced beyond the query-obvious traveller type, so the decisive test for real causal reasoning is largely unmet.
